description: LibreChat MCP server integration resolves ${VAR} placeholders against process.env during URL validation. Authenticated user can craft MCP config with env var references, leaking CREDS_KEY, CREDS_IV, JWT_SECRET, and MONGO_URI to attacker-controlled endpoint.
Mass assignment in assistant update endpoint allows modifying workspaceId to reassign assistants across workspaces, breaking tenant isolation in multi-workspace deployments.
Path traversal in Plugin Daemon REST API allows authenticated users to access internal debug endpoints across tenants using unencoded dot sequences in task IDs or filename parameters.

When JWT auth enabled, OIDC userinfo cache uses token[:20] as key. Identical JWT header prefixes from same algorithm produce cache collisions. Unauthenticated attacker crafts token matching legit user's cache prefix, inheriting identity and permissions.

OpenWebUI validate_url() only checks initial URL; downstream HTTP clients follow 3xx redirects to internal addresses (127.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, RFC1918) without re-validation, leaking internal response bodies.
IBM Langflow OSS 1.0.0-1.9.1 allows authenticated users to read/modify sensitive info by bypassing authentication using insecure direct object references (IDOR).

Authenticated editor users can set trace configurations for any application regardless of tenant ownership, redirecting all messages and responses from victim apps to attacker-controlled LLM trace providers.
